name: 039.2 — the Position type, and hafen.world()
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 039.2: hafen.world() is a section whose gobs are one read-only collection and whose spatial verbs take a Position; a Position is computable (the engine crosses grid boundaries) and durable (it saves as a grid anchor and comes back a Position); hafen.gob and the four retired position verbs throw naming their replacements. Stores one Position of its own (account scope) so the reload check can prove the marshalling.
